purpose: Select a deterministic DRP spatial-symbol bandwidth using train-only Marmousi wavefields before any target5 frozen validation or test_id truth is generated or opened.

data_contract.selection: stable source_f0_hz quantiles including both endpoints

sweep_contract.promotion_rule: A DRP variant may advance to a larger train-only confirmation only if its mean relative L2 is lower than standard_taylor8 and it is the preregistered ranking winner. This sweep alone cannot promote a frozen validation or test result.

test_evidence.command: PYTHONPATH=src:. python -m pytest -q tests/test_drp_coefficients.py tests/test_train_only_drp_sweep.py tests/test_lwc84_core.py tests/test_lwc84_cpml.py tests/test_lwc84_solver.py

prohibited_uses: No validation or test_id wavefield may be read during bandwidth selection.
No target5 frozen truth may be generated until the deployable algorithm and evaluation contract are frozen.
No claim of the 5 percent or 10x target may be made from this train-only sweep.
